notes.title: Update 18.09.2017
notes.content:
Here is an update with a few bug fixes and some quality of life improvements.

Improvements

Now you can see enemy movement range just like you see yours. Just select an enemy ship and you will see which tiles it can move to.
Lab improvement. Now, when you have selected a first item to combine, the list of items to combine with it will be automatically limited to those eligible. No more scrolling through all your items searching for the duplicate.


Bug fixes

Fixed bugs with certain achievements. If you had issues with some achievements, start the game and load your profile, then all achievements you're qualified for should be unlocked.
Fixed a bug when players did not receive gold for replaying a mission on a difficulty they have already completed.
Fixed a bug when ship's reisistances did not go to normal after leaving a tile with defence bonus.
